rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: This server wraps the Windows Sandbox CLI (wsb.exe) to provide complete sandbox lifecycle management on Windows 11 24H2 or later. Built as a .NET global tool, it enables initialization with customizable configurations including vGPU settings, networking options, memory allocation, and mapped folders. The implementation includes command execution within sandbox environments, shared directory management, and remote session window control with structured JSON output parsing. It incorporates safety checks for OS compatibility and single-instance enforcement, making it valuable for automated testing environments, secure code execution, malware analysis, and development workflows requiring isolated Windows environments.
